dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: Are you interested in learning any new Thespian Tricks? By which I mean dashing and elegant poses! In fact, what would you say to a friendly exchange? I'll teach you some Thespian Tricks in return for Toy Medals from the treasure chests.

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: Friendship is a wonderful thing, isn't it? Ah, just the word itself gives me a warm, fuzzy feeling in my heart and stomach...

choices.text: It is a lovely thing indeed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep yep! Gotta love friendship... But, uh, when you say a warm, fuzzy feeling in your stomach... There is something slightly concerning about that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaanyway... Are you sure you're okay with just Toy Medals? What can they be worth if they're just toys?

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: As long as you believe, even Toy Medals can be more valuable than gold. That is the magic of imagination. Madame Mage told me that. I can't say I entirely understand what she meant, but...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: The Thespian Tricks — I actually got those from a wish I made to Madame Mage. So as long as she thinks it's a fair trade, I think it should be fine...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, sounds kinda ominous... Don't a lot of scary stories start out that way? You make a reckless wish to a wicked witch, but you end up regretting it when she forces you to pay an impossible price in return...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: I believe you're misunderstanding the situation, dear guest. There is absolutely nothing to fear. To start with, mages are quite different from wicked witches. And besides, I already told you what the price is — it's the Toy Medals. There's no catch!

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Yes, completely! In any case... I was the one who made the wish, so if someone has to end up paying an impossible price, just leave it to me!

choices.text: ...Why do you sound so proud of that?

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: I enjoy watching your performances, so it's well worth it as far as I'm concerned! Hmm, I wonder how many blank pages are left in this book...

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: Ah, but not to worry. Even if we run out of space, new blank pages will be added very soon!

response.speaker: Wolfy
response.text: I do look forward to the day when all empty pages are filled with stories...

choices.text: We still feel a little bad...
All my best friendships are built on a warm, fuzzy feeling in my stomach.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh for the love of... Please don't tell Paimon you're thinking about "emergency food" again? We're talking about friendship here, okay? Paimon will never understand why that's where your head goes...

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I still have some work to do before everything is ready... Thank you for your patience, my dear guests.

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: If you'd like, you can take the stage and perform once more. There'll be Toy Medals waiting for you in treasure chests afterwards!
